headline: Week in review: The deepening K-shaped economy, stubbornly high rates
summary: Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi is joined by LPL Financial chief technical strategist Adam Turnquist, 42 Macro founder and CEO Darius Dale, and Senior Business Reporter Ines Ferre to break down the week's biggest market and economic developments, including the deepening K-shaped economy and why interest rates remain at "uncomfortably high" levels.
